reviews.title: Way less cables
reviews.comment:
These things are awesome. I went from 7 case fans (3 top, 3 front, 1 rear) all with separate RGB cables and power cables, to replacing the 3 top fans with 3 QX Corsair links up top and it feels like I cut the cables in my case by half.

While iCue can be a bit annoying to use, you can always rely on BIOS fan curves (if you want, not necessary) and use something like SignalRGB to handle your lighting setups. 

The set up for the fans is easy, especially if you’re an experienced PC builder you won’t even need to look anything up. If you do, there are great guides on YouTube for setting up.
